notes: The charging dock is model CDZ11RR or CDZ12RR.

gaps: No separate robot model code is used here.
method: The iFixit teardown names the Roborock S5 Max and covers the battery and its connector, the side brush motor and the LiDAR; the motherboard is mentioned in the battery step.
The CE user manual's Basic parameters tables give the robot battery as 14.4V/5200mAh lithium and the charging dock as 28W.
Qty, ext and obs are editorial ratings.

comps.spec: Motherboard. The battery connector attaches to it; the battery step warns against tearing the connector off the motherboard.
Side brush motor, held by screws. Remove its screws, then lift it out.
Charging dock, rated power 28W, model CDZ11RR or CDZ12RR.
LiDAR with a LiDAR cage; the cage and the LiDAR each have their own screws. Remove the cage screws, then the cage, then the LiDAR screws, then the LiDAR.
comps.loc: LiDAR step of the iFixit teardown (guide 177443)

comps.spec: Battery connector. Squeeze the connector to release it. Yanking the battery out can tear the connector off the motherboard.
comps.loc: Between the battery and the motherboard

sources.title: iFixit: Roborock S5 Max teardown guide (battery, motherboard, side brush motor, LiDAR steps)
